source: Zhu et al., Xianghe County, China, June 2004, n=1671. Tables I, III, IV and V, publisher pages 147, 150 and 151.
interpretation: The four threshold counts are sums across folate/B12 categories, grouped by ferritin and anemia. Table I labels ferritin inconsistently; the methods, Table III and the deficiency definition give micrograms per litre. Table V reports an adjusted logistic odds ratio. The article gives no continuous Hb–ferritin Spearman coefficient.
